_how_these_were_computed: Independently of plan.py (scratch caseA.py from the verification): each 2026 day takes last year's day 364 days earlier (same weekday, same distance from Black Friday: 27 Nov 2026 <- 28 Nov 2025) up to 23 Dec, and the same calendar date from 24 Dec on, then x 1.10 rounded half up. Mai 8h weekdays, Lan 8h weekdays and 4h weekends, x 0.75 = 12.0 weekday, 3.0 weekend. Backlog by hand: 21 Nov 5.0 - 3.0 = 2.0; 22 Nov 5.0 + 2.0 - 3.0 = 4.0; 23 Nov 6.6 + 4.0 = 10.6 <= 12.0 so 0; 27 Nov 19.8 - 12.0 = 7.8; 28 Nov 16.5 + 7.8 - 3.0 = 21.3; 29 Nov 14.3 + 21.3 - 3.0 = 32.6; 30 Nov 18.7 + 32.6 - 12.0 = 39.3; 1 Dec 15.4 + 39.3 - 12.0 = 42.7. Bill: Nov 1112 + 1045 = 2157, 157 over -> 2 blocks x 36 + 300 = 372; Dec 3432, 1432 over -> 15 blocks = 540 + 300 = 840; Jan 1309 -> 300 (lower bound).
